constraints: INDEPENDENT SESSION REQUIRED. You did not author the contract.

THE ATTAINABILITY CHECK IS A NAMED, EXPLICIT DUTY AND GETS ITS OWN DELIVERABLE FILE, attainability_check.md. A review that passes the contract without a band-by-band and branch-by-branch attainability verdict is itself incomplete, and this instruction exists so that the duty cannot be treated as implicit.
Redo every load-bearing arithmetic quantity yourself rather than accepting the contract's numbers.
If REVISE at any severity, the batch records non-execution for the run under the RC-22 one-cycle cap.
Test the pre-registration adversarially - try to construct a result the rule cannot classify, or classifies two ways, and say so if you find one.

Test INT-1 adversarially - name any way in which the sampled quantity could fail to be the half-arity Semaev intermediate, in the spirit of RT047-H2 and RT048-H1 which caught exactly that error in the previous sampling.
Confirm the contract expressly forbids the smoothness_abort flag-flip anti-pattern.
Confirm the contract reuses the EXP-DS-001 KS, rate-band and tail thresholds verbatim and redrafts none of them.
Confirm claim_tier toy; no S1_met, no support and no asymptotic path under any branch; promotion gates G1-G4 remain OPEN.
Confirm no file under experiments/EXP-DS-001/ is edited and that H-DS-001, H-IC-001 and H-STR-002 are untouched.
Confirm the run declares manifest.yaml with the companion filenames tools/validate_ledger.py check_run requires - command.txt, environment.json, stdout.log, stderr.log, raw-result.json.
MAKE NO COMMIT. Do not author repairs; report defects.
Do not alter any ledger record.
handoff.objective: Return PASS or REVISE on experiments/EXP-SMTH-001/specification.yaml at the TASK-20260801-011 snapshot. FIVE QUESTIONS DOMINATE AND EACH MUST BE ANSWERED EXPLICITLY AND SEPARATELY. (1) THE ATTAINABILITY DUTY, WHICH IS YOUR FIRST AND NAMED DUTY AND WHICH GETS ITS OWN DELIVERABLE FILE. Check ATTAIN-RR-SMTH-1 band by band and branch by branch: for M-0, M-5 (each of its three legs), M-1, M-2, M-4 and M-6, and for every rung of both frozen Bsm ladders, does some ACHIEVABLE measurement land there given this sampling design and these frozen thresholds? Redo the arithmetic yourself - C(513,2) = 131328, the factor-8 rate bands about the tabulated rho values, the KS threshold max(0.05, 1.63/sqrt(131328)), the two-sample threshold 1.63*sqrt(2/131328), the expected smooth counts n*rho(u) at every rung, and the DECAY-1 threshold 100*rho(6)/rho(2). If ANY band or branch is unreachable at the chosen parameters, that is a REVISE. This duty exists because BATCH-021's map was exhaustive and honestly applied and its favourable branch D-2 was still arithmetically unreachable, so the experiment could not have confirmed the hypothesis even had it been true. (2) IS THE READING RULE GENUINELY PRE-REGISTERED - verify against Git yourself that the TASK-20260801-011 commit contains the contract and that its tree contains no run artifact of any kind; check that RR-SMTH-1 is exhaustive over the outcome space with a declared precedence order; check that its thresholds are inherited from EXP-DS-001 rather than invented, and that the two ADDED variables KS2-DS-1 and DECAY-1 are declared as additions with thresholds derived rather than chosen. (3) IS INT-1 THE INTERMEDIATE OR A NEW STAND-IN - this is the question the whole lane turns on. Attack the claim that the elementary symmetric functions of the roots of S_3(x_i, x_j, Z), encoded by ENC-B, are a faithful integer encoding of the half-arity Semaev partial map's image. Say whether a different faithful encoding could carry a different smoothness law, and whether the contract's scoping of the result to INT-1 and ENC-B is honest about that. (4) DOES EVERY DECISION VARIABLE VARY WITH THE THING IT MEASURES - attack the bijection argument in decision_variable_variation_check directly, and say whether any decision variable is a closed form in the protocol's own parameters in the way BATCH-021's charged-unit proxy was. (5) IS THE NULL GENUINELY MATCHED - matched in count, in range [1, p**2], and in code path, per docs/inventor-protocol.md section 3.2. Also rule explicitly on the declared D_formula reading and on the Bfb = 512 departure from H-DS-001's test boundary. Independent session; do not author repairs.
